AC Milan monitoring Man Utd's Fernandes - Sunday's gossip
- Published
AC Milan are monitoring Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes, Arsenal pair are yet to start talks on new deals and Trabzonspor renew their interest in Tottenham forward Richarlison.
AC Milan are monitoring the situation of Portugal midfielder Bruno Fernandes, 32, who has yet to agree a contract extension with Manchester United. (Corriere dello Sport - on Italian), external
Manchester United are set to rival Tottenham for Freiburg's £50m-rated Croatia striker Igor Matanovic, 23, during the January transfer window. (Goal), external
Norway midfielder Martin Odegaard, 27, and Germany forward Kai Havertz, 27, are about to enter the remaining 18 months of their deals at Arsenal but talks with both about extending their contracts have yet to begin. (Standard), external
Trabzonspor have renewed their interest in Brazil forward Richarlison, 29, with Tottenham looking for a fee of around £10m. (The i Paper), external
Juventus are working on a permanent move for Newcastle United loanee Nick Woltemade and may be willing to include Portugal winger Francisco Conceicao, 23, in a swap deal for the 24-year-old Germany forward. (Gazzetta dello Sport via Goal), external
Jack Grealish, 31, is not on Celtic's radar as multiple clubs monitor the former England attacking midfielder, who is out of contract at Manchester City in the summer and currently on loan at Everton. (Football Insider), external
Nottingham Forest's English winger Callum Hudson-Odoi, 26, is a potential January target for Roma. (Teamtalk), external
Uruguay defender Ronald Araujo, 27, says it is too early to think about turning his loan move from Barcelona to Liverpool into a permanent switch. (Athletic - subscription required), external
But Barcelona have given Liverpool the green light to complete a £47m deal to buy Araujo. (Mirror), external
Tottenham striker Mikey Moore, 19, is expected to see out the rest of this season at Cologne as there is no clause in the England Under-21 forward's deal that would allow Spurs to recall him early. (Talksport), external
Tottenham have joined Juventus, Como and Galatasaray in being linked with 32-year-old Turkey captain Hakan Calhanoglu as the midfielder continues contract talks with current club Inter Milan. (Tuttomercato), external

digest_he:
מועדון הפאר איטלקי מילאן עוקב מקרוב אחר מצבו של קשר מנצ'סטר יונייטד, ברונו פרננדש בן ה-32, שטרם הגיע להסכמות על הארכת חוזהו בקבוצה האנגלית. במקביל, שחקנים נוספים מוזכרים בהקשר של מעברים אפשריים בחלון ההעברות הקרוב.

בין היתר, ארסנל טרם החלה בשיחות על חוזים חדשים עם מרטין אודגור וקאי האברץ, בעוד שטרבזונספור חידשה את עניין בחלוץ טוטנהאם רישארליסון, ויופנטוס בוחנת אפשרויות צירוף שחקנים נוספים לקראת חודש ינואר.
